book.name: REVELATION
book.title: Matsh Haschu g Jesus Christ am i Maskogi John Wui

content: Oꞌohana am ha wui hegam mash am kihdag Sardis t am

K hab ep kaij ab ni-wui, “Am g oꞌohanid g ha wanimeddam hegam mo ab si ni-hiwig ch am kihdag Sardis t am. T heg am wo ha ahgi mani hab kaij: “Id o d haꞌichu ni-ahga ahni mani an uꞌukch g wewaꞌak huhuꞌu ch am kehshch g Hekia S-apꞌekam Gewkdag mat wewaꞌak masma wo e chehgidad em-wehhejed. S-mahch ani mam has chuꞌig. Bam em-elid mam d s-apꞌekam. Mt eda e mehkod ab ni-amjed.
Neh, mt ab wo i nehnen k ab wo i gewkai hegai mam haschu wabsh kia edgid mat koi wo s-ap muh. Pi o hohhoꞌid g Jiosh hegai mam haschu am hab junihim.

Am g wo s-chegitok mam wa haschu ab em-mashcham k ab wo i s-wohog elid k gam hu wo s-ohhod g pi ap e-chegitoi. Kumtp pi wo sha nehnen, nt s-aꞌagi ia wo jiwia hab sha masma mo g s-chu ehskam. Kumt pi wo shaꞌi mahchk g ohla mant hekid wo i jiwia.
“Haꞌijj ahpim amai Sardis t am am hi wa si e nuhkud mat pi haꞌichu wo em-uamhu. Ahpim mam s-ap am hab e junihim amt ni-wehm wo himad s-tohtam e enidadadch.

Hegam mat hedai wo gewito g pi apꞌekam at s-tohtam wo e enigadad. An o oꞌohadag g ha-chechgig an dahm kahchim ch ed mo d e doꞌibiakam. Kunt pi wo shaꞌi oa g ha chechgig k wabshaba hab wo chei am tahgio g ni-ohg Jiosh ch am ha tahgio g anghiligaj mo d ni-hemajkamga.
“Hekia S-apꞌekam Gewkdag o am i maskogid g haꞌichu ni-ahga am em-wui ahpim mam ab si ni-hiwig ch am kihdag ha eꞌeda hegam wewaꞌak kihhim. Kumt wehsijj ab wo kaihamad.”
Oꞌohana am ha wui hegam mash am kihdag Philadelphia t am

K hab ep kaij ab ni-wui, “Am g oꞌohanid g ha wanimeddam hegam mo ab si ni-hiwig ch am kihdag Philadelphia t am. T heg am wo ha ahgi mani hab kaij: “Id o d haꞌichu ni-ahga ahni mani d hekia s-apꞌekam ch d wohokam ch an uꞌukch g Davidbad yahwi. Id ani hekaj haꞌichu kukpiꞌok. T pi hedai wo e nako mas ab ep wo kuh. Kuni haꞌichu kukpa. T pi hedai wo e nako mas ab ep wo kuhpiꞌo.
S-mahch ani mam pi am hu i si s-gewpkdag ch wabshaba am oidch hab e junihim g ni-mashchama ch ab si ni-hiwig. Ab ant i hema kuhpiꞌo g kihjeg em-wehhejed. T pi hedai wo e nako mas ab ep wo kuh.

“Haꞌi o hab e aꞌaga mo d Tutuligo ch d Jiosh hemajkamga. K eda hab chuꞌig mo d wabsh Jiawul hemajkamga. Bant wo ha juh mat ab wo i hihi em-wui k ab wo i shulig k ab wo si has i em-el. T wo wehsijj s-mai mani ahpim ab si em-tatchua.
“Am am hab junihim g ni-chehanig ch s-bahbgim ab nakog haꞌichu. Nt heg hekaj wo em-nuhkud heg amjed kudutadag mo ab him ha wui g wehs hemajkam mat am wo ha aꞌappe wehs jewed shuhdgim.
S-hohtam ant wo jiwia. Am g wo si nuhkud hegai mani ab em-mahkch. T hab pi hedai wo shaꞌi em-wohppoꞌi hegai mani ab em-makiog hahawa.

“Bant wo ha juh hegam mat wo gewito g pi apꞌekam mat d wo uꞌugchuk am Jiosh kihdag ed hab sha masma mo g che-tondag am geꞌe cheopi ed. Kut idam pi hekid wo shaꞌi dagito g Jiosh kihdag. An ant ha ab wo oꞌoha g ni-Jioshga chehgig ch g Jiosh kihhim chehgig. Jiosh kihhim o d Wechij Jerusalem ch ab wo i hud Jiosh amjed an dahm kahchim ch ed. Ab ant ha ab ep wo oꞌoha g ni-wechij chehgig.
“Hekia S-apꞌekam Gewkdag o am i maskogid g haꞌichu ni-ahga am em-wui ahpim mam ab si ni-hiwig ch am kihdag ha eꞌeda hegam wewaꞌak kihhim. Kumt wehsijj ab wo kaihamad.”
Oꞌohana am ha wui hegam mash am kihdag Laodicea t am

K hab ep kaij ab ni-wui, “Am g oꞌohanid g ha wanimeddam hegam mo ab si ni-hiwig ch am kihdag Laodicea t am. T heg am wo ha ahgi mani hab kaij: “Id o d haꞌichu ni-ahga ahni mani s-ap wohokamchud g wohokam ab amjed g Jiosh ch am wehs dahm g Jiosh nahtoi.
S-mahch ani mam has chuꞌig. Bam chum e elid mam s-ap ab ihm g Jiosh. Kum eda pi am hu woho i e dagitokch wui.
Nt heg hekaj gam hu hab wo i em-juh ab ni-amjed hab sha masma mamt gam hu wo wiho g wabsh s-huhk wasib.

Bam chechꞌe mo am wabsh i s-em-apꞌe haꞌichu nam pi d s-kakais ch hab ep chechꞌe mam pi haꞌichu ep shaꞌi tatchua. Ni wabshaba em-ahgid mam si shoꞌig ch s-ta hoꞌigeꞌidama ch gm wabsh i s-dadpk ch pi nenea.
Ab g wo i e dagito ni-wui k hab masma wo edagi g s-wohom kaisdag ch s-kehg wehschuga ch kulani am wehhejed g em-wuhpui. Kumt hahawa pi wo shoꞌigk ch pi wo s-dadpk ch wo s-neneak.
Haꞌichu ani shohbid ch ha gewittan hegam mani ab si ha tatchua mat hekaj gam hu wo s-ohhod g pi ap e-chegitoi.

“Neh, ab ani em-waid ni-wui. K heg wa wepo mani ab kehk em-kihjeg ab ch ab shontpag ch ab em-chehcheg. Kumt wo kah mani ab neok k wo i kuhpiꞌo g kihjeg. Nt ab wo i wah. Kutt ab aꞌai wo t-ihmad ch t-wehm wo si s-hehgigk hab masma matt hems wo t-wehm t-gegosidad.
Ni-ohg Jiosh at an ni-dai e-hugid an kownal ni-daikud an nant pi gewito g pi apꞌekam. Kunt ahni am hab waꞌap wo em-dai ni-hugid an kownal daikud t ab mamtp hedai wo gewito g pi apꞌekam.
“Hekia S-apꞌekam Gewkdag o am i maskogid g haꞌichu ni-ahga am em-wui ahpim mam ab si ni-hiwig ch am kihdag ha eꞌeda hegam wewaꞌak kihhim. Kumt wehsijj ab wo kaihamad.”
